Country.profileDescription: Choose your username and country of residence to start recording your mountain adventures.
Country.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: letters A–Z, numbers, underscore, dot or hyphen. Start and end with a letter, number or underscore.
Country.profileIncomplete: Complete your profile before using this feature.
Country.countryRequired: Choose a valid country of residence.
Country.usernameUnavailable: This username is unavailable. Please choose another.
Country.alreadyCompleted: Your profile is already completed. Use account settings to change your country.
Country.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Country.oauthError: Sign-in could not be completed. The authorization may have been cancelled or expired. Please try again.
Country.confirmationDescription: If this address can be registered, a confirmation email will arrive. Open its link in this browser, then complete your profile. If you already have an account, sign in.
Country.registrationError: Registration could not be completed. Check your details or try signing in.
Country.countryUpdated: Your country of residence has been updated.
Country.legacyPrompt: Choose your country to unlock your national ranking and country mountain progress.
Country.countryRankingDescription: Ranking for users living in {country}. Residence is self-declared.
Country.remainingCount: {count, plural, one {# mountain remaining} other {# mountains remaining}}
Country.coverage: Progress across mountains in the Mountain Tracker catalog. Coverage may be incomplete; this is not a list of every mountain in the country.
Country.catalogEmpty: There are no mountains for this country in the catalog yet. Progress is unavailable.
Country.invalidFilters: Check the filters: use a valid height range and up to 100 search characters.
Country.profileMissing: Your profile could not be loaded. Try again later; if this continues, contact support.
Country.description: Select the country where you live. This is your own declaration, not your nationality.
Country.noResults: No matching countries. Your existing selection has been kept.
Country.countryHint: Your country determines your national ranking and country mountain progress. This is residence, not citizenship.
Country.changeNote: Changing your residence country changes your country ranking and country progress only. Your ascents and achievements remain unchanged.
Country.settingsSubtitle: Manage your profile and residence country.
